allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 6.5 m at 6 years and 7 m at 15. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: yellow-green culms, fresh green leaves.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a running bamboo 4 to 9 m tall that spreads from its rhizomes into dense groves of straight, yellow-green culms 2 to 5 cm thick, each reaching its full height within a few weeks of emerging and living about seven years, leafy above with sprays of narrow leaves at its nodes. A woody grass whose culms live for years, so its growth form is shrub. Not fitted to measurements.

generator.params.cane_length.note: How the cane program draws a bamboo grove from a flora's sizes, a choice of the model's (spec rework E2): a cane as long as the culms' greatest usual length, and at its foot as thick as the stoutest culms.

generator.params.cane_radius.note: How the cane program draws a bamboo grove from a flora's sizes, a choice of the model's (spec rework E2): a cane as long as the culms' greatest usual length, and at its foot as thick as the stoutest culms.

generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the cane base: it gives the values the cane program gave as defaults until then. Homed at the genus, as the library has no rank for the bamboos' subfamily yet.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (plant forms milestone F6). Calibration against measurements and photographs comes later.
